title: Kenyan-Style Beef Dumplings
description: A hearty and flavorful take on traditional Kenyan dumplings, filled with tender beef and spices.
instructions: Combine flour and warm water to form a dough. Knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide dough into small balls, about the size of a small egg. Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press edges together to seal.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, then add the dumplings, cooked in batches if necessary.
Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown. Repeat with remaining dumplings.
Transfer cooked dumplings to a serving plate. Serve immediately, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
